assets.label: Extension zip (load unpacked or upload to the Chrome Web Store)

plugins.prepareCmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),f='public/manifest.json',m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f));m.version='${nextRelease.version}';fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(m,null,2)+'\n')" && npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../google-dashboard-${nextRelease.version}.zip .
plugins.publishCmd: if [ -n "$REFRESH_TOKEN" ]; then npx -y chrome-webstore-upload-cli@4 --source google-dashboard-${nextRelease.version}.zip; else echo 'Chrome Web Store secrets not set: skipping store upload'; fi
